events.title: Watch the developer play the demo!
events.summary: Hi everyone! 🐝Join us for a gameplay session straight from the person who built the game. I’ll be playing Honey or Else, showing off the core gameplay loop.Like what you see? Add Honey or Else to your wishlist to get notified about the release! ❤️

events.title: The bears are here! DEMO UPDATE
events.summary: The bears 🐻 finally showed themselves! A bear can spawn randomly and slowly approach your hive, when he reaches his target he will attack it and slows down honey production by 50% for a period of max 60 seconds. events.title: DEMO out now!
events.summary: Hello beekeepers!I'm happy to announce that the first demo of Honey or Else is now available! 🐝If you forgot what this game is about: Honey or Else is an incremental game about bees forced to make honey for their bear captors, while secretly plotting to free their Queen. Plant flowers, hire bees and upgrade the hive!This demo should last for a few hours of idle gameplay to max out the skill tree.
